stats.metric: Raw win rate and pick rate per keystone (no adjustment for player skill or draft). Game counts are derived: pick rate x champion matches, rounded.
stats.patchNote: u.gg labels patches by year (26.20); Riot's own numbering for the same patch is 16.20.

wiki.note: Ranged values (Kog'Maw is ranged). Per-level values at levels 1 to 18.

keystones.name: Lethal Tempo
keystones.wiki: Attacks on champions stack up to 6 times, +4.8% attack speed each (28.8% max). At 6 stacks, attacks fire a bolt: 6 to 21.7 damage, +1% per 1% bonus AS.

keystones.name: Stormraider's Surge
keystones.wiki: Deal 25% of a champion's max HP within 3s: +36% move speed and 50% slow resist for 4s. Cooldown 20 to 8.8s.

keystones.name: Press the Attack
keystones.wiki: 3 hits on one champion: 40 to 174 adaptive damage, then +8% damage to them until out of combat. Cooldown 6s.

keystones.name: Arcane Comet
keystones.wiki: Ability damage drops a comet: 15 to 110 (+10% bonus AD, +5% AP). Cooldown 20 to 6.6s.

keystones.name: First Strike
keystones.wiki: Hit a champion first: 3s of +7% bonus true damage, then gold equal to 35% of that bonus damage. Cooldown 25 to 15s.
